newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World air cargo volume up 9.1 pct in July - ACI.
newsitem.headline: World air cargo volume up 9.1 pct in July - ACI.

text.p: Freight and mail traffic handled by 488 airports around the world in July 1996, totalled 4.10 million tonnes, up 9.1 percent on the same month the previous year, said Geneva-based Airports Council International (ACI).
North America, the biggest of ACI's six cargo-handling regions, reported 2.12 million tonnes of freight traffic, up 12.3 percent on July 1995.

Airports in the Asia/Pacific region (in which ACI incorporates Indo-China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Malaysia and Australia), handled 843,668 tonnes, an increase of 4.4 percent on July last year, ACI said.
July 1996 cargo traffic handled at ACI's Europe member airports totalled 826,888 tonnes, a rise of 3.5 percent on the same month in 1995.

Middle East airports' cargo rose 11.2 percent to 135,431 tonnes while Latin America/Caribbean airports' also tabled double-digit growth in freight traffic volume increasing 18.1 percent on July 1995 to 111,750 tonnes.
African airports recorded the highest percentage growth of ACI's cargo-handling regions in July rising 35.2 percent to 56,092 tonnes. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
